item.title: Polk County Issues Water Advisory For Big Butternut Lake Due To Blue-Green Algae
item.description: POLK COUNTY -- The Polk County Public Health Department has issued a water advisory for Big Butternut Lake due to blue green algae blooms in the lake. Blue-green algae, technically known as cyanobacteria, are microscopic organisms that are naturally present in lakes and streams. They usually are present in low numbers. item.title: Name Released In Fatal ATV Vs. Deer Crash In Polk County
item.description: POLK COUNTY — Polk County Sheriff Brent Waak has released the name of the man who died in a fatal ATV crash on Tuesday, August 19, 2025. The operator of the ATV was John Smith, 70, of rural Balsam Lake, Wisconsin, according to the sheriff. The crash occurred at 3:34 p.m. on 150th Avenue, east of County H in the town of Apple River. item.title: Wisconsin Governor Tony Evers Highlights $8.7M Child Care Payments In Radio Address
item.description: MADISON — Gov. Tony Evers today delivered his weekly radio address highlighting the first round of direct payments awarded to providers through the Child Care Bridge Payments Program. Funds from this first month’s payment, totaling $8.7 million, were awarded to more than 3,100 providers across the state and will support the retention of 25,531 staff and the care of 126,181 kids. item.title: Judge Reviews Video, Testimony; Sentences Webster Man For Violent Incident
